name: Blox-47
_comment: Not a staff NPC (docs/NPCS.md). The only verbs are open_inpc (the shell's Wake / chat panel) and sleep_inpc (forget the key). No pay / wire / approve / cancel / priority / provision — docs/INPC.md.

booting.text: Blox-47's eye stays dark while the branch opens.

dormant.text:
A brass plate reads BLOX-47. Its eye is dark.

It can talk you through how the bank works and read your passbook and the vault board back to you — but it only thinks with a link of your own. Paste an OpenRouter key to wake it; the key lives in this tab until it sleeps.

awake.text: Blox-47's eye is lit. It reads the same board you do, and it cannot touch a penny of it.

choices.text: Put it to sleep (forget the key)

asleep.text: The eye goes dark. The key and the conversation are gone from this tab.

why_key.text:
The branch keeps no AI key of its own and runs no relay: your browser talks to OpenRouter directly, with the key you paste, and the key is held only in this tab's session storage — Sleep wipes it, and so does closing the tab.

Blox-47 is a reader. It is handed a snapshot of what your passbook and the vault board already show — nothing from behind the counter — and it has no way to sign, pay, wire, release, recall or open anything. Staff at their desks do those, and only with your signature.
